title: Item 9 Calibration — Stage C risk-class recommendations
description: Implement deterministic, advisory-only Item 9 Stage C recommendations from Stage B calibration output. Insufficient canonical evidence produces no numeric token or retry/repair recommendation. Sufficient canonical token evidence may produce a deterministic advisory token-budget candidate, but never auto-applies policy, never relaxes risk/gates, and always requires a separate governance task for policy mutation.

why_medium: This stage interprets governance telemetry and can influence later policy review if recommendations are accepted.
A defect could create misleading recommendations even though the stage is explicitly non-applying and cannot mutate runtime or governance policy.
The implementation is additive and isolated to multi-agent scripts, tests, Task Contract, Item 9 documentation and generated Task Catalog.
why_not_high: No risk floor, Review/Security/Human Gate, retry policy, token budget, merge policy, workflow, runtime, API, database, migration, auth, payment, pricing or inventory behavior is changed.
All recommendations are advisory and any future policy mutation requires a separate governed task.

dependencies.name: Item 9 Stage B deterministic calibration engine

lock.rule: No conflicting writer may mutate these paths until the Stage C PR is merged or aborted.

recommendation_policy.retry_repair_rule: No numeric recommendation until retry/repair distribution is explicitly present in canonical calibration evidence.
recommendation_policy.risk_and_gate_rule: NO_CHANGE; Stage C cannot relax risk floors or verification gates.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C is MEDIUM and requires exact-artifact Review PASS plus ACTIVE lock evidence. Security and Project Owner Human Gate are not required unless deterministic risk escalates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Stage C accepts only Stage B-shaped canonical-readback calibration reports with policy_mutation_allowed=false.
INSUFFICIENT_CANONICAL_TELEMETRY emits no numeric token-budget recommendation and reports the exact sample gap.
Sufficient canonical token evidence may emit only an advisory candidate using deterministic P75/P90/MAX derivation with strict positive ordering.
Retry/repair receives no fabricated numeric recommendation because Stage B does not expose a canonical retry/repair distribution.
Risk floors and Review/Security/Human/Merge gates are always NO_CHANGE in Stage C and any future mutation requires a separate governance task.
Process-friction recommendations are derived only from visible sample gap, missing telemetry and excluded-sample counts; anecdotal pilot behavior does not become a numeric calibration input.
Invalid quantile order, inconsistent sufficiency status, noncanonical source or mutating calibration report fails closed.
Current canonical repository evidence remains zero committed telemetry paths, so LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH each receive NO_NUMERIC_RECOMMENDATION and NO_CHANGE for risk/gates.
Stage C is advisory-only: automatic_apply=false and policy_mutation_allowed=false in all output.
Existing wildcard multi-agent tests include Stage C without package.json or workflow mutation; full canonical verification remains green.
PR diff is limited to the five declared Stage C write-scope paths.
Protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge canonical plus Phase A verification must pass before Stage C is canonically complete.
